mid-team-e1.label: LSG middle overs run rate, 2022–2023
mid-team-e1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
mid-team-e1.query: SELECT SUM(d.total_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2023 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13)

mid-good-seasons.label: Seasons LSG scored faster than the league in the middle overs
mid-good-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
mid-good-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

midw-l0.label: IPL win rate after losing no wickets in the middle overs
midw-l0.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
midw-l0.query: WITH w AS ( SELECT i.innings_id, i.match_id, i.batting_team_id bt, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT w.wk, CASE WHEN w.bt IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_t, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = w.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM w JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = w.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL

midb-lead-name.label: LSG's most-used batter in this phase, 2024–2026
midb-lead-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
midb-lead-name.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id = d.batter_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bnd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 0 AND d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 6 AND 14 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY d.batter_id HAVING balls >= 80 ORDER BY balls DESC LIMIT 8
